title: reverifyEngagement request
description: POST /v1/engagements/{engagementId}:reverify - request. Requests an interactive re-verification of one engagement through the fan-out worker (downstream ~1 min). Asynchronous: the result arrives as EngagementVersionInspected.v1 -> projection update -> notification.
$comment: Source: DISENO S7 (d) FanOutCommandSender, (e) 'POST /v1/engagements/{id}:reverify (enqueues INTERACTIVE priority)', (f) StartFanOutJob.v1 / EnqueueFanOutTasks.v1; DISENO 4.4 CMD-03, CMD-04; S4 (b) PriorityClass; PRD RF-021. Audience: PUBLIC (served to the UI). Residency: REGIONAL (cell of the firm, resolved by the stateless global edge firmId -> cell, RF-093); the firm comes from the authenticated context, never from the URL; the command stays in the cell (CMD-03/CMD-04 to ms-publish-fanout of the same cell). Idempotency: Idempotency-Key required: jobId = UUID v5 of the key, so a repeated request returns the same job (DEC-35). Pagination: n/a.

headers.description: Contract-relevant request headers (platform/transport headers are out of scope). correlation-id is optional from the UI (generated by ms-experience-gateway when missing, DISENO 3.8.5) and mandatory on service-to-service and operator calls (propagation, RF-120). idempotency-key is required on every write (DISENO 3.8.5, DEC-35).
